PZZ700-060815-
1224 PM PDT Mon Oct 5 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1022 high was located over central Nevada, and a 1012
mb low was located over central California. Hurricane Rachel was 
approximately 850 nautical miles south of San Diego, with a
minimum low pressure center of 976 mb. Weak offshore flow during 
the mornings and weak onshore northwest flow during the afternoons
will prevail through Tuesday. More persistent and weak northwest 
flow is expected Wednesday through Friday.

$$
